title: header search placeholder visible search control
rule: Header search may use placeholder + visible Search control — the only named placeholder-as-visible-label exception: visually hidden `<label>`, placeholder “Zoek”, submit with text and/or magnifying-glass. Does not pass on ordinary fields. Dual-cite Forms no-placeholder-as-label. Placeholder/label lock unchanged.
pass_when: Header search: hidden `<label>` + placeholder “Zoek” + visible Search control. Ordinary fields still have a visible label (lock).
fail_when: An ordinary field uses placeholder as its only label, citing this exception; or header search has no visible Search control and no accessible name.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Placeholder-as-label as passing on non-search fields; GOLD search attributes as this exception.
